e93efd40.text:
Day 1

Venture Co. activity continues to be a concern. Their mining operations have only grown, and I hear a new, grinding sound that suggests some new horrific construct may have been unloaded there.

I do not yet consider them a capable threat to Thunder Bluff, but if provoked they could successfully mount an attack on Bloodhoof Village from the south.
e93efd40.title: Longwalker Malah's Report

10666|43217733.name: Gordo
10666|43217733.text: Us is busy with important things!

10666|5f4181c7.name: Gordo
10666|5f4181c7.text: Oh yeah. Us gots it right here.

10721|a05588c0.name: Novice Warrior
10721|a05588c0.text:
<Novice Warrior gulps.>

I can do this.

11051|32f7eed3.name: Vhan
11051|32f7eed3.text: No part of the animals we hunt is wasted.

11833|eb2e4319.name: Rahauro
11833|eb2e4319.text:
Well met, $c. You may speak to me unless you have direct business with my mistress Magatha.

I deal with most of her tasks for her so she can concentrate on more important matters. Perhaps there are some things we could discuss before you seek audience with her?

11869|49ff395c.name: Ansekhwa
11869|49ff395c.text: I would be honored to train you in the use of the weapons that I have mastered should you have the ability to learn within you.

1496|54d7bdcd.name: Deathguard Dillinger
1496|54d7bdcd.text: Take it, then. It seems Zygand is too busy for the agonizing trip here to retrieve it himself.

1515|778f03ac.name: Executor Zygand
1515|778f03ac.text: The Scarlet Crusade is encroaching on our homeland. The foolish zealots do not realize that the loyal servants of The Dark Lady shall see to their demise.

205729|2fb0f637.name: Boarton Shadetotem
205729|2fb0f637.text:
Most impressive that you have noticed me, $r. You may have a talent for the shadows.

I am Boarton Shadetotem, a master of the arts of stealth and subtlety. You may find the idea of a $r rogue implausible, even impossible. For many years I took pride that my skills were mine alone. But I have seen my people face unimaginable challenges, and I now feel a duty to share my knowledge with the tribe.

214954|6cf4abd2.name: Rix Xizzix
214954|6cf4abd2.text:
Welcome to the Xizzix Asset Recovery Service! If you lost it, we probably found it! 

Check my stock to see if we've recovered anything that you might have carelessly discarded and have since decided you just can't live without.

227853|066d9580.name: Pix Xizzix
227853|066d9580.text: Impulse purchases are the most fun kind of purchases!

2425|7dca81fc.name: Varimathras
2425|7dca81fc.text:
Do not presume to speak to me as though you are my equal, $c. Sylvanas is my queen, and I will do as she bids.

If you do not show the proper respect, I assure you, we can find a more than suitable place for you in the Nether.

But there is no reason we cannot have words if you wish to aid the Dark Lady...

248201|5de3438e.name: Pawani
248201|5de3438e.text: Greetings, friend! I have an ample supply of leather and hides, and I know a few techniques I might be willing to share. Interested in doing business?

251001|379c835f.name: Deathguard Kristof
251001|379c835f.text:
Please do see that he reads it at once. I fear our Scourge problem has only just begun.

Come see me again in due time. I believe I have nearly uncovered something I could use a willing blade to help with.

267009|6f316d7a.name: Hadric Harlson
267009|6f316d7a.text: Be careful, $c. There are cultists nearby.

267330|0371bf6f.name: Nawka Wildsong
267330|0371bf6f.text: Care to learn how to gather leather from slain beasts? Or do you need some new tools?

2980|e775a01e.name: Grull Hawkwind
2980|e775a01e.text: Greetings, $N, and welcome to Camp Narache. News of your arrival spread quickly among the tribe.

2981|72360bcb.name: Chief Hawkwind
2981|72360bcb.text: Hail, $c. In my years I have seen many eager $r who wish to prove their worth to the tribe. It should not be forgotten that eagerness is no substitute for wisdom and experience.

2988|00c35128.name: Morin Cloudstalker
2988|00c35128.text: The Outrunners' duty is to ensure the safety of those who travel across the plains of Mulgore. Those that would threaten the safety of the $r homeland risk punishment at our hands.

2993|f7a5deb4.name: Baine Bloodhoof
2993|f7a5deb4.text: The land has been good to our people, $c. We must be thankful for our good fortune.

2995|bfaf54b7.name: Tal
2995|bfaf54b7.text: When mounted on the back of a wind rider, one sees that its reputation for strength and speed is well earned.

3026|0c543544.name: Aska Mistrunner
3026|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

3028|c2467ddc.name: Kah Mistrunner
3028|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

3043|4711dbab.name: Ker Ragetotem
3043|4711dbab.text: No matter how much one learns, there is always more to know.

3052|25d0fbd5.name: Skorn Whitecloud
3052|25d0fbd5.text: Come closer, young one.  In my time I could hear the flutter of a prey's beating heart, but now you must speak up if you want your words heard.

3057|690a7170.name: Cairne Bloodhoof
3057|690a7170.text:
Greetings young one, and welcome to Thunder Bluff.  You'll find safe refuge from the burdens of the world here.  All denizens of the Horde are welcome here.

The spirits of the present and past come alive here in this sacred place, my friend.  Honor them, and in doing so honor yourself.

3059|4711dbab.name: Harutt Thunderhorn
3059|4711dbab.text: No matter how much one learns, there is always more to know.

3062|1605f087.name: Meela Dawnstrider
3062|1605f087.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

3063|4711dbab.name: Krang Stonehoof
3063|4711dbab.text: No matter how much one learns, there is always more to know.

3065|2d23ed1c.name: Yaw Sharpmane
3065|2d23ed1c.text: I do not have the knowledge you seek.

3066|1605f087.name: Narm Skychaser
3066|1605f087.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

3067|0c543544.name: Pyall Silentstride
3067|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

3067|b48f927f.name: Pyall Silentstride
3067|b48f927f.text: I can teach you how to cook!

3084|3f6c5bac.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|3f6c5bac.text: Komin Winterhoof at Holistic Herbalism is the one you want to talk to then.  He can be found on the middle rise.

3084|4d981406.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|4d981406.text: Go see Una at Thunder Bluff Armorers then.  It can be found on the middle rise.

3084|6b3c7794.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|6b3c7794.text: The profession of Enchanting displays the cycle of destruction and creation that is at the heart of nature.  Teg at the Dawnstrider Enchanters on the middle rise will show you how.

3084|8c257f1a.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|8c257f1a.text: Aspiring to join our ranks one day?  Sark Ragetotem can help you on your way.  He's in the Hunter's Hall.

3084|b2444ac7.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|b2444ac7.text:
Don't blame you for taking up fishing.  Mulgore has some the best fishing spots in Southern Kalimdor and Mountaintop Bait & Tackle on the high rise has all of the gear you'll need to take advantage of it.

Tell Kah Mistrunner that I sent ya!

3296|89286116.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|89286116.text: It is good that you wish to honor your kills by putting their bodies to use.  Find Thuwd inside the Kodohide Leatherworks in the middle of The Drag.

3309|2f8d506f.name: Karus
3309|2f8d506f.text: Besides the Grunts outside, my brothers and I fought at the battle of Hyjal. Any who seek to steal from the bank must face us first.

3309|6b36598f.name: Karus
3309|6b36598f.text: I guarantee this bank's security with my own blood, is that good enough for you?

3309|ae78a458.name: Karus
3309|ae78a458.text: Would you rather trust your goods with a goblin?

3310|cc0cf280.name: Doras
3310|cc0cf280.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

3318|2f8d506f.name: Koma
3318|2f8d506f.text: Besides the Grunts outside, my brothers and I fought at the battle of Hyjal. Any who seek to steal from the bank must face us first.

3352|fd7e1800.name: Ormak Grimshot
3352|fd7e1800.text: I have much knowledge to impress upon you, $c. You must learn to hunt with honor.

3390|eb12150e.name: Apothecary Helbrim
3390|eb12150e.text: The Barrens holds a wealth of substances for which we, the apothecaries or Lordaeron, may find use.

3406|08e320c2.name: Xor'juul
3406|08e320c2.text: What kin I do for ya, mon?

3412|d0fc10c2.name: Nogg
3412|d0fc10c2.text: If there were just a few more hours in a day...

3413|c879b3f9.name: Sovik
3413|c879b3f9.text: Hello, $N! If you don't see it in my shop, chances are good I can get it!

3429|4e7d06f7.name: Thork
3429|4e7d06f7.text:
Welcome to the Crossroads, $c. My name is Thork--I lead the defenses here in the name of the Warchief.

Please, feel free to make yourself at home. As long as you mind your business, no one should have any problem with you taking up some space.

There are many threats to our safety here. If you've already become familiar with the lay of the land, speak to the others here--perhaps they have tasks for you to do.

3448|dcea3712.name: Tonga Runetotem
3448|dcea3712.text: The times we live in are as fickle as the shifting winds, $c.  It is important to remember what is true and lasting in this world, and to preserve that.  Everything else is a waste.

3483|aa3c8600.name: Jahan Hawkwing
3483|aa3c8600.text: The Barrens, with its hot sun and hostile denizens, is the perfect place to test your strength and fortitude.

3549|2cec462d.name: Shelene Rhobart
3549|2cec462d.text: Skin, glorious skin. It holds your insides... in. You might've noticed my skin's not doing so well. To think I used to worry about my pores. Hardly any skin left to worry about these days. In a way, it's very freeing.

3615|ddd7878b.name: Devrak
3615|ddd7878b.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

3685|3bad330d.name: Harb Clawhoof
3685|3bad330d.text:
Greetings, $c. I am happy Anshe has guided you to me today. I would be proud to sell you one of our finest kodos once you have trained with Kar.

The kodo is a noble beast, but is prone to its own behaviors that make it different than most steeds. Once you learn from Kar you will have no issues traversing the world with one at your side.

3934|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Boorand Plainswind
3934|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

5759|a28d29e1.name: Nurse Neela
5759|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

5769|c9ae2675.name: Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem
5769|c9ae2675.text: The earth keeps many secrets, $c; it is our duty to ensure that those that must remain a secret for the good of all stays as such.

5888|9a3b3109.name: Seer Ravenfeather
5888|9a3b3109.text: The earth calls to you, MEGAHUGH. Go to it, and know that your brethren are proud of you and all you will accomplish.

5939|a28d29e1.name: Vira Younghoof
5939|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

6741|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Norman
6741|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

6746|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Pala
6746|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

6747|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Kauth
6747|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

6929|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Gryshka
6929|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

7853|967b8e4a.name: Scooty
7853|967b8e4a.text: Hello, $N! I am master engineer, Scooty.

1505-accept.name: Krang Stonehoof
1505-accept.text:
The Horde honors its warriors because their strength is unquestioned.  But the truly great warriors are great students as well.

Seek out Uzzek.  He is a veteran of many battles and now instructs young warriors in the ways of combat.  You will find him south of Far Watch Post, the orc garrison on the border of the Barrens and Durotar to the east.
1505-accept.title: Veteran Uzzek

95805-complete.name: Unknown
95805-complete.text: <As you empty the incense into the fire, the scent wafts around you, leaving you with just the empty pouch and a subtle sense of fulfillment.>
95805-complete.title: Grace of An'she and Mu'sha

95805-progress.name: Unknown
95805-progress.text: <The smoke from the incense rises toward the sky.>
95805-progress.title: Grace of An'she and Mu'sha

97931-accept.name: Kaga Wildhoof
97931-accept.text:
So you've taken up First Aid? That's an honorable... and pragmatic pursuit as a $c.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.
97931-accept.title: Camping 101: First Aid

97931-complete.name: Vira Younghoof
97931-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own First Aid Kit. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97931-complete.title: Camping 101: First Aid

97935-accept.name: Kaga Wildhoof
97935-accept.text:
Mining isn't the most glamorous, but it's good honest work and a fine profession for you to explore.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Lodestone for your camp. Build one of these and everyone who wants to swing a sword will be eager to gather round your fire and soak up the extra "oomph" it can provide to increase their combat prowess.
97935-accept.title: Camping 101: Mining

97936-accept.name: Kaga Wildhoof
97936-accept.text:
Being able to skillfully harvest the skins and hides of fallen beasts is one of the more valuable skills an adventurer can possess.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Camp Chair for your camp. Sometimes it's important to just take a load off, and you can use some of those hides you've gathered to make a comfy chair to sit in. A bit of relaxation can help ensure that you are at your peak condition and can strike where it counts the next time you find yourself in a dust-up.
97936-accept.title: Camping 101: Skinning

97936-complete.name: Yonn Deepcut
97936-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Camp Chair. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97936-complete.title: Camping 101: Skinning

98424-accept.name: Unknown
98424-accept.text:
Some particularly worn papers are held separately, folded in Fizsprocket's inside breast pocket.

They seem to detail important information that could be used against the Venture Co. and its operations in the region. It would be prudent to look for more before returning to Morin Cloudstalker.
98424-accept.title: Fizsprocket's Notes

98424-complete.name: Morin Cloudstalker
98424-complete.text:
Ah, this is most valuable knowledge. I thank you for your efforts.

<Morin looks through the notes.>

It seems our next move is clear.
98424-complete.title: Fizsprocket's Notes

98424-progress.name: Morin Cloudstalker
98424-progress.text: What is it you bring me, $c?
98424-progress.title: Fizsprocket's Notes

99411-complete.name: Ahab Wheathoof
99411-complete.text: Fantastic work, $N! Kyle came home as soon as he ate and went straight to bed. Thank you for your help.
99411-complete.title: Kyle's Gone Missing!
